tasks.title: Author the nested-stack template
tasks.goal: Create a complete child template that accepts parameters, creates one SSM parameter and exposes outputs to the parent.
tasks.whyItMatters: The child becomes a reusable component managed by AWS::CloudFormation::Stack.

consoleSteps.title: Author the nested-stack template

instructions.text: Open C:\\cloudformation-labs\\fa-cloudformation\nested.yaml.
Replace the empty file with the complete nested.yaml block below and save it as UTF-8.
Review Environment and NestedMessage.
Confirm the fixed resource name is /fa-cloudformation/nested-message.
Review the Outputs section that the parent can read.

jsonBlocks.title: nested.yaml
jsonBlocks.content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Nested stack for the fa-cloudformation SAA-C03 Follow Along.
Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: training
    AllowedValues: [training, test]
  NestedMessage:
    Type: String
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 80
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$'
Resources:
  NestedParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /fa-cloudformation/nested-message
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub '${NestedMessage}-${Environment}'
      Description: Created by the nested CloudFormation stack.
      Tags:
        FollowAlong: fa-cloudformation
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
Outputs:
  NestedParameterName:
    Value: !Ref NestedParameter
  NestedParameterArn:
    Value: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter${NestedParameter}'

tasks.title: Author the root template with parameters and a condition
tasks.goal: Create the root template that creates a root parameter, conditionally creates another parameter and invokes the nested template by URL.
tasks.whyItMatters: One template can change behavior through runtime inputs instead of being copied for each environment.

consoleSteps.title: Author the root template with parameters and a condition

instructions.text: Open C:\\cloudformation-labs\\fa-cloudformation\root.yaml.
Paste the complete root.yaml block and save it.
Review Environment and RootMessage constraints.
Review CreateOptionalParameter and the CreateOptional condition.
Review NestedTemplateUrl; it receives the S3 URL at deployment time.
Confirm OptionalParameter has Condition: CreateOptional.
Confirm NestedTrainingStack is AWS::CloudFormation::Stack and passes two child parameters.
Review the Outputs, including !GetAtt from the child stack.

jsonBlocks.title: root.yaml
jsonBlocks.content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Root stack for the fa-cloudformation SAA-C03 Follow Along.
Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: training
    AllowedValues: [training, test]
  RootMessage:
    Type: String
    Default: created-by-fa-cloudformation
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 80
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$'
  CreateOptionalParameter:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
  NestedTemplateUrl:
    Type: String
    MinLength: 20
Conditions:
  CreateOptional: !Equals [!Ref CreateOptionalParameter, 'true']
Resources:
  RootParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /fa-cloudformation/root-message
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub '${RootMessage}-${Environment}'
      Tags:
        FollowAlong: fa-cloudformation
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
  OptionalParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Condition: CreateOptional
    Properties:
      Name: /fa-cloudformation/optional-message
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'optional-${Environment}'
      Tags:
        FollowAlong: fa-cloudformation
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation
  NestedTrainingStack:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::Stack
    Properties:
      TemplateURL: !Ref NestedTemplateUrl
      Parameters:
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        NestedMessage: nested-created
      TimeoutInMinutes: 10
Outputs:
  RootParameterName:
    Value: !Ref RootParameter
  OptionalParameterCreated:
    Value: !If [CreateOptional, 'true', 'false']
  NestedParameterName:
    Value: !GetAtt NestedTrainingStack.Outputs.NestedParameterName
  NestedStackId:
    Value: !Ref NestedTrainingStack

tasks.title: Author the self-managed StackSet roles template
tasks.goal: Create the administration and execution roles declaratively in a dedicated CloudFormation template.
tasks.whyItMatters: Self-managed StackSets need a trust path from CloudFormation to the administration role and then to the execution role.

consoleSteps.title: Author the self-managed StackSet roles template

instructions.text: Open C:\\cloudformation-labs\\fa-cloudformation\stackset-roles.yaml.
Paste the complete roles template and save it.
Confirm the administration role name is fa-cloudformation-stackset-admin-role.
Confirm the execution role name is fa-cloudformation-stackset-execution-role.
Confirm the administration role can assume only the exact execution role.
Confirm the execution role can manage only /fa-cloudformation/stackset-message plus DescribeParameters.
Do not add AdministratorAccess.

jsonBlocks.title: stackset-roles.yaml
jsonBlocks.content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-managed StackSet roles for the fa-cloudformation training lab.
Resources:
  StackSetAdministrationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: fa-cloudformation-stackset-admin-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: fa-cloudformation-assume-execution-role
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/fa-cloudformation-stackset-execution-role'
  StackSetExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DependsOn: StackSetAdministrationRole
    Properties:
      RoleName: fa-cloudformation-stackset-execution-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt StackSetAdministrationRole.Arn
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: fa-cloudformation-stackset-ssm-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [ssm:PutParameter, ssm:GetParameter, ssm:GetParameters, ssm:DeleteParameter]
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:eu-west-2:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/fa-cloudformation/stackset-message'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:DescribeParameters
                Resource: '*'
Outputs:
  AdministrationRoleArn:
    Value: !GetAtt StackSetAdministrationRole.Arn
  ExecutionRoleName:
    Value: !Ref StackSetExecutionRole

tasks.goal: Deploy fa-cloudformation-root with the optional parameter disabled and confirm the nested child is created automatically.
tasks.whyItMatters: The parent owns the child lifecycle and should be used for normal create, update and delete operations.

consoleSteps.title: Create the root and nested stacks
consoleSteps.instruction: Open CloudFormation in eu-west-2 > Stacks > Create stack > With new resources.

instructions.text: Open CloudFormation in eu-west-2 > Stacks > Create stack > With new resources.
Choose Upload a template file and select root.yaml.
Set Stack name to fa-cloudformation-root.
Set Environment=training.
Set RootMessage=created-by-fa-cloudformation.
Set CreateOptionalParameter=false.
Paste the exact NestedTemplateUrl recorded in Task 9.
Continue with default stack options and no service role.
Review and submit the stack.
Wait for CREATE_COMPLETE.

instructions.text: Template means declarative desired state.
Stack means one managed collection of resources.
Parameter means runtime input without editing the template.

Change set means previewing proposed stack changes before execution.
Drift means actual managed state differs from expected template state.

Exam trigger: manual out-of-band changes -> drift detection.
Exam trigger: preview stack impact before update -> change set.
